trigger: 声明一个操作依赖 when its declared inputs are available.

inputs.name: upstream_operation
inputs.description: Object with required keys `operation_id` and `outputs`; operation_id identifies one upstream instance.

inputs.name: downstream_operation
inputs.description: Object with required keys `operation_id` and `inputs`; operation_id identifies one downstream instance.

inputs.name: required_artifact_or_state
inputs.description: Object with required keys `name`, `kind`, and `reason` for the one artifact or state that must flow.

inputs.name: existing_dependency_edges
inputs.description: Array of edge objects, each with required keys `upstream_id`, `downstream_id`, and `artifact_or_state`, used only for duplicate and cycle checks.

preconditions: 两个实例身份明确且依赖有数据或状态理由
Use only this single-action procedure; source or upstream instance references must be supplied.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: One 操作依赖边 in the common envelope; data fields: dependency_edge.

postconditions: 边指向实际前置条件；不引入循环或凭空限制顺序
The typed result and provenance agree with the declared single-action scope; unsupported required fields withhold a resolved result.

implementation.target_environment: Source interpretation or strategy reasoning; no SpaceClaim runtime.
implementation.notes: No standalone deterministic interpreter is claimed. Apply only MS-04 in the hash-bound guidance reference using atomic-reasoning-protocol.md.

ambiguity_checks: Reject an edge justified only by visual order, stage labels, or convenience rather than a required artifact or state.
Reject self-edges, cycles, duplicate edges, and operation identities that are not explicit.
Do not turn a dependency edge into a complete recipe or hidden operation sequence.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: No geometry handles are acquired; declarations do not mutate or refresh application topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared action inputs cannot support a unique required result.
failure_modes.detection: Apply the action rejection rules and inspect raw source evidence.
failure_modes.safe_state: Return actionable unresolved fields; retain original evidence and values.

recovery.action: Supply only the missing source or prerequisite, then repeat this action; do not invent geometry or start application execution.

validation.method: Inspect named inputs, result fields, procedure and rejection rules for MS-04
validate_atomic_reasoning.py with an actual source manifest; separately review interpretation against raw material.
validation.expected: 边指向实际前置条件；不引入循环或凭空限制顺序

host_checked.notes: Host structure/invariants and bounded independent source evaluation; no automatic promotion.

evidence_level.notes: Candidate. Structural tests cannot establish source interpretation accuracy or any SpaceClaim runtime capability.
